name: Boomtect
title: Boomtect · Make your own thunder
description: Boomtect simulates the sound of lightning, blasts, and sonic booms from their physics: shape them in 3D, place microphones, and hear what arrives.
socialDescription: Simulate the sound of lightning, blasts, and sonic booms from their physics. Shape a flash or a storm in 3D, place microphones over real terrain, and listen in stereo, binaurally, or export Ambisonics.
imageAlt: Boomtect showing a branching lightning channel in 3D above a microphone, with its thunder's waveform
